description: A faithful embroidered plush tiger Codex pet with orange-gold yarn panels, a cream belly, thick stitched stripes, and a curled toy tail.

idle.notes: Calm resting idle with tiny breathing and blink motion.

walk.notes: Short low plush steps used for directional movement and follow behavior.

curious.notes: Gentle head tilt, paw lift, and focused inquisitive look.

happy.notes: Soft pleased reaction with brighter smile and tiny paw lift.

sleep.notes: Warm ground-hugging sleep loop with visible cream belly and curled tail.

pet_react.notes: Satisfied post-pat squish with half-closed eyes and tiny head press.

roll.notes: Playful roll onto the back and curl back into a cuddly loaf.

pounce.notes: Tiny affectionate pounce forward with a very short lift and settle.

drag.notes: Directional drag reuses the true-facing locomotion rows.

follow.notes: Follow uses the same true-facing short run rows as walk so the tiger stays low and companion-like.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
left drag uses the true left-facing row
right drag uses the true right-facing row
head, body, stitched stripes, paws, and curled tail stay directionally unified in both walk rows
